bean.name: ShiroSecurityPolicy
bean.title: Shiro Security Policy
bean.description: An authorization policy that authenticates the caller with Apache Shiro, from the encrypted ShiroSecurityToken sent with the message, and checks its permissions and roles. Create it with the Shiro INI resource as its constructor argument, or set securityManager.

cipherService.label: advanced
cipherService.description: The cipher service that decrypts the ShiroSecurityToken sent with the message. AES by default; Shiro also ships a Blowfish one.

passPhrase.label: security
passPhrase.description: The key the ShiroSecurityToken sent with the message is decrypted with.

securityManager.description: The Shiro security manager that authenticates and authorizes the caller. The constructors build it from a Shiro INI resource; set it when the security manager comes from elsewhere.

permissionsList.description: The permissions an authenticated caller needs to continue on the route. Any one of them is enough unless allPermissionsRequired is set.

rolesList.description: The roles an authenticated caller needs to continue on the route. Any one of them is enough unless allRolesRequired is set.

alwaysReauthenticate.description: Whether to authenticate the caller on every exchange. When false, the first caller is authenticated once and only exchanges from that same user are let through afterwards.

base64.description: Whether the ShiroSecurityToken header is a base64 string rather than the token object, which lets it travel over JMS and other transports.

allPermissionsRequired.description: Whether the caller needs all the permissions in permissionsList, rather than any one of them.

allRolesRequired.description: Whether the caller needs all the roles in rolesList, rather than any one of them.
